newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian shares rise in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian shares rise in active trade.

text.p: Egyptian share prices rose in busy trading on Monday with the market still seen as cheap and attractive, brokers said.
The Capital Market Authority (CMA) all-share index closed 0.03 points higher at 234.87 after shares worth 32.54 million pounds ($9.57 million) were traded.
"The market is still performing well and regarded as very cheap and very attractive," said Neveen El Tahry of Delta EAB brokerage. "Traditionally popular sectors still dominate."
North Cairo Flour Mills dominated the trade with shares worth 4.99 million pounds changing hands. The share closed 0.26 pounds higher at 95.61.
In the milling sector, Southern Cairo Flour Mills was also a winner, adding 1.25 pounds to finish at 44.25 pounds. 26,525 shares worth 1.17 million pounds were traded.
Cement firms still perform well, with most of them going up.
Suez Cement, among the market leaders, rose 0.24 pounds to close at 42.00 pounds after shares worth 2.1 million pounds changed hands.
Amriyah Cement also increased to 55.00 pounds, adding 1.00 pound, with shares worth 1.12 million traded.
The CMA index for openly traded firms rose to 340.50 points from 339.48 on Sunday and the index for rarely traded "closed" firms steadied at 160.64.
Gaining stocks outnumbered losers 22 to 8 while another 26 firms were traded but ended unchanged.
